svg.aria-label: From a log line to a LogQL answer: 1. Receive: Promtail pushes batches to loki-headless on port 3100. The NetworkPolicy admits only monitoring, rook-ceph and DNS replies. 2. Chunk: The ingester holds streams in memory and a WAL under /var/loki/wal, then cuts chunks of snappy-compressed blocks, 256 KiB each. 3. Store: Chunks and the TSDB index, schema v13, live on a 50 GiB ceph-block volume. With no object store, that volume is the whole data set. 4. Expire: The compactor deletes streams past 14 days. Ingest is capped at 10 MB/s with a 20 MB burst. 5. Query: Grafana's Loki datasource sends LogQL to port 3100. Loki's own request metrics feed three alerts.
